required_properties: The expand step is safe to rerun and does not remove or rename Email.
Old and new writers remain usable throughout the compatibility window.
Backfill runs in bounded batches and can resume after interruption.
Reconciliation detects nulls, mismatches, and duplicate normalized values.
The contract step is separate, online-compatible, and blocked until reconciliation passes.
Rollback restores the prior write path without discarding accepted writes.
azure_sql_notes: Do not rely on SQL Server Agent.
Keep transactions short enough for an Azure SQL deployment window.
State any edition or service-tier assumptions for online index operations.
